Do not include private data or security exploit details. For security reports,
follow the [security policy](https://github.com/puyu-tech/puyudb/security/policy).

## Need

Who needs this, what are they trying to do, and what is missing from the current
implementation? Distinguish a new proposal from an existing project goal.

## Proposed scope

Describe the smallest useful behavior, acceptance criteria, and explicit non-goals.
Which interface is affected: library, `puyu db`, or a future optional service?

## Alternatives

What can be done today? Why is a project change preferable?

## Offline behavior and compatibility

Can it work without a network or account? Describe any effects on existing APIs,
stored formats, migrations, interoperability, or optional components. Mark unknowns
and do not assume a supported data format already exists.

## Security, privacy, and dependencies

What data is recorded, shared, or exposed? Identify new permissions, trust
boundaries, dependencies, license obligations, and unresolved risks, or explain N/A.
